_comment: LOOK_AT defaults to the OPPONENT and its 'target' was unread, so "look at the top card of YOUR deck" was looking at the opponent's -- not a dead effect, an information leak pointing the wrong way. The target named a zone but never a player, and the shared target parser refuses to guess one, so the card now says player SELF outright. The bottoming half then named the zone as "top_deck", which is not a Player attribute, so getattr found nothing and the card bottomed NOTHING -- and it was mandatory where the text says "you MAY put it on the bottom". "It" is the card just looked at, so this reads the ref LOOK_AT stores rather than re-deriving a zone. The +1{d} also went to the defending TOTAL rather than to THIS card.
